source_priority_definitions.P0: daily-refresh distress sources (clerk, court, sheriff, code, tax delinquency) — at least one P0 must be unblocked for a shippable build
source_priority_definitions.P1: weekly-refresh distress sources (sheriff weekly PDFs, bulk extracts) — supplement only, cannot be sole distress feed
source_priority_definitions.P2: enrichment sources (parcel master, GIS, USPS, utility) — supporting context, never the headline

build_priority_definitions.mvp_required: build first to ship minimum viable lead pipeline
build_priority_definitions.high_value: high-value lead source, build after MVP
build_priority_definitions.enrichment: supporting enrichment, no leads on its own

source_reliability_grade_definitions.A: official source of truth (clerk recorder, tax collector, court of jurisdiction direct)
source_reliability_grade_definitions.B: official but delayed (same official source delivered via public-records request or scheduled bulk)
source_reliability_grade_definitions.D: scraped public display only, not authoritative

changelog.summary: Recon protocol Gaps 4-7 (Protocol 01 §01.28-§01.32), each closing a class of false recon outcome. Gap 4: access-control ENFORCEMENT must be tested before any blocked classification — a control that exists is not a control that blocks; adds SINGLE_LAYER_HUMAN_VERIFIABLE / MULTI_LAYER / PER_REQUEST_CHALLENGE tiering, and a single-layer human-verifiable control is explicitly NOT a build blocker but an operator-assisted session handoff. Gap 5: lead type names are framework vocabulary, not local vocabulary — terminology must be established empirically from the jurisdiction's own controlled vocabulary, and the ORIGINATING event must be separated from downstream stages of the same distress process; adds NOT_APPLICABLE_IN_JURISDICTION. Gap 6: tax roll, delinquency list, and balance lookup must be searched and classified separately, with a delivery-mechanism preference order and a state-level fallback; a tax sale list does not substitute for a delinquency feed. Gap 7: freshness must be verified from max actual record date, not advertised cadence; adds LIVE/LAGGING/FROZEN/UNKNOWN, and a FROZEN source cannot satisfy the P0 gate. Four new gate tests auto-discovered from scaffold/tests/v5_6_0/.

Source category expansion: 5 new mandatory Phase 0.A search queries (bankruptcy court, public notices, land bank, treasurer/tax billing, UCC/entity enrichment). Lead type sweep 27->29 (Bankruptcy Notice, Public Notice). UCC/entity classified ENRICHMENT_SOURCE + build_priority:future. Protocol 01 and matrix 16 updated.
